title: PRISM forge-audit overlay
description: Per-node coloring instructions consumed by system-viz.html. Color encodes wired/orphan/bridge state derived from forge-audit-omniscient phase outputs.

sourceAudit.description: Path of the AUDIT-LATEST.json this overlay was derived from.

systemGraphSha.description: SHA of the system-graph.json this overlay was computed against (8-char hex).

nodeId.description: Matches a node id in system-graph.json (typically the file path or DSL shortcode).

color.description: green = wired+tested+documented · yellow = wired only (missing tests OR docs) · red = orphan (zero inbound, importance > 0) · blue = bridge-missing (1-hop pair in same domain that should be 0-hop)

reason.description: One-line human reason — surfaced in viz tooltip.

shortcode.description: DSL shortcode (E####, D##, A##, T####) when resolvable. Empty string if no shortcode applies.

suggested_unit.description: Suggested U-* unit name to remediate this node, when applicable.

domain.description: Domain bucket from coverage-by-domain.json (mill, lathe, edm, physics-safety, ai-reasoning, cad-ingest, cam-bridges, knowledge-memory, quote-erp-biz, ux-studios, other).
